$comment: Closed asset-role vocabulary. Wired through schema/pagespec.schema.json (definitions.assetRole enum + per-field const/enum), tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json (assetRoles) and the example PageSpecs. verify_all.py checks parity, wiring, the pinned policies, the policy<->generatedMode coherence and that no generated example uses a blocked role. Two PageSpec modes exist (see modes): 'reference' (local clone use) and 'generated' (a new website); each role carries a generatedMode classification.

generationPolicyMeaning.may-generate-new: A generator may create a new original asset for this slot.
generationPolicyMeaning.reference-context-only: Existing asset may appear only as-is inside this local reference; never altered, imitated, or used elsewhere.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-fabricate: Real third-party trademark: never generate, imitate, name or reuse. Operator supplies licensed assets.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-reuse-in-new-pages: Proprietary Tines content: slot only; supply operator-owned content.
generationPolicyMeaning.snapshot-not-source-art: Runtime-art screenshot: placeholder only, not source art, not reusable.
generationPolicyMeaning.operator-supplied-only: Slot for the operator's/user's OWN asset, supplied by them with rights to use it: the generator never creates, redraws or imitates it and must not substitute any real brand's mark.

pinnedPoliciesNote: Compliance-critical roles whose policy must equal this exact value (a membership-in-enum check alone would accept a different-but-valid value).

meaning.reference: PageSpec reproduces/describes the local clone of the source site. Roles classified blocked-in-generated (the real Tines logo) are allowed in their allowedSections.
meaning.generated: PageSpec is a NEW website for someone else. No role classified blocked-in-generated may appear anywhere in the spec, the source brand name may not appear in any text, and every section that expects a brand mark must use a generation-safe brand role (brand.placeholder or brand.user-supplied).

generatedModeMeaning.generation-safe: Allowed in a generated PageSpec: contains no Tines or third-party source asset (generic glyphs, neutral placeholder, the user's own asset).
generatedModeMeaning.slot-operator-supplied: Allowed in a generated PageSpec only as an empty slot the operator fills with their own or licensed assets; the Tines/third-party original is never reproduced (policies must-not-fabricate, must-not-reuse-in-new-pages, snapshot-not-source-art).
generatedModeMeaning.blocked-in-generated: Reference mode only. Presence anywhere in a generated PageSpec is an error (GENERATED_NO_REFERENCE_ASSET). Policy reference-context-only.

policyToGeneratedModeNote: Closed mapping checked by verify_all: every role's generatedMode must equal the mode its generationPolicy maps to, so the two vocabularies cannot silently disagree.
pinnedGeneratedModeNote: Exact-value pins (membership in generatedModeEnum alone would accept a different-but-valid value such as generation-safe for the real Tines logo).

sourceBrand.name: Tines
sourceBrand.note: In generated mode the source brand name may not appear in any PageSpec string (alt text, labels, copy), so the brand cannot leak as text either.

brand.tines-logo.description: Tines logo / wordmark / footer logo icon (Tines trademark).
brand.tines-logo.guidance: REFERENCE MODE ONLY. Only the existing chrome asset, unmodified, inside this local reference. Never redraw, recolour, imitate or place it in content sections. In a generated PageSpec this role is an error anywhere (use brand.placeholder or brand.user-supplied). Any use outside the local reference needs Tines' permission.

brand.placeholder.description: Generation-safe stand-in for a brand mark: a neutral, clearly-labelled placeholder (plain box or the operator's own site name set as text in the page's own type tokens).
brand.placeholder.guidance: Use when the operator has not supplied a logo. Must be a plain placeholder or text-only wordmark of the new site's OWN name: no glyph, symbol, lettering or colour treatment derived from or resembling the Tines logo or any other real brand. This repo ships no artwork for it by design.

brand.user-supplied.description: The user's/operator's own logo, supplied at generation time (slot only).
brand.user-supplied.guidance: Slot for an asset the user provides and has rights to. The generator never creates or imitates it. Preferred over brand.placeholder whenever a real logo of the new site exists.

customer.logo-trademark.description: Real third-party customer trademarks in the marquee (Canva, Coinbase, Databricks, Dropbox, Intercom, McKesson, MongoDB, Pinterest, Reddit, Snowflake, Sophos).
customer.logo-trademark.guidance: Never generate, redraw, name or reuse real logos, and never list real customer names as endorsements in new pages. A generated marquee holds operator-supplied, licensed logos only (logoSource 'operator-supplied-licensed-logos').

partner.assistant-icon.description: Third-party AI assistant marks in the footer Ask-AI pill (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok).
partner.assistant-icon.guidance: Third-party trademarks. Do not redraw or invent assistant marks; do not add assistants.

product.demo-frame.description: Captured frames of Tines' proprietary scripted product demo (phone/tablet/desktop SVG).
product.demo-frame.guidance: Proprietary product UI. New pages must use the operator's own product imagery in this slot; never reproduce or fabricate Tines product screens or UI copy.

product.screenshot.description: Tines product screenshots per team tab (workflow / frontend JPGs).
product.screenshot.guidance: Proprietary screenshots. Slot only; supply operator-owned screenshots. Never fabricate Tines UI.

illustration.brand-art.description: Tines' proprietary illustrations: ai-tangle, orb mascot, radar + constellation, USP card icons.
illustration.brand-art.guidance: Do not copy or trace. A generator may describe a NEW original illustration brief for the slot, but must not reproduce these artworks or their characters.

artwork.canvas-standin.description: PNG snapshots of runtime procedural canvases (100x wordmark, monitor wall, solution flower bed, Start-today wordmark).
artwork.canvas-standin.guidance: These are screenshots of runtime art, NOT source art: no layers, no licence, not reusable. Treat as a placeholder slot; never present them as editable assets or reuse them in new pages.

editorial.promo-image.description: Nav Discover dropdown blog / event card images.
editorial.promo-image.guidance: Real editorial imagery about real events/customers. Slot only; never reuse or invent real events.

icon.ui-glyph.description: Small functional glyphs (tab icons, chevrons, arrows, hamburger).
icon.ui-glyph.guidance: Generic UI glyphs: may be newly drawn at the iconSize tokens in color.text.* tokens. Do not copy Tines' exact glyph artwork outside this reference.

fontPolicy.status: commercial licensed typefaces self-hosted by Tines
fontPolicy.rule: Generated pages may reference the fontFamily/typography TOKENS only within this local reference context. Production use requires obtaining licences from the foundries. Never redistribute, embed, upload or copy the WOFF2 files; this design-repo ships none.

licensing.source: Clone of a real, live company's site (Tines). Commercially sensitive.
rules: Local reference only; do not publish or make this design-repo public.
No generating or reproducing real logos, real customer names as endorsements, real employee/customer photos, or Tines proprietary product screenshots/copy beyond short headings.
All links in the source go to the live tines.com (or are dead root-relative paths in the clone); PageSpecs carry CTA intents, never live URLs.
Two PageSpec modes: 'reference' may carry brand.tines-logo; 'generated' must not (anywhere, as asset or as text) and must use brand.placeholder or brand.user-supplied for every brand mark.
